defect.proposed_fix: Keep 'Treatment: good (as of 2026-06-30)' and 'Binding — SCOTUS,' but replace 'No negative treatment' with 'No confirmed negative treatment in the lake record; treatment derivation includes proposed negative/progeny edges requiring audit.'

reasons: The lake judgment field supports good_law as of 2026-06-30 and has no point_overrides.
Every disclosed treatment edge is marked proposed, with field_iii 'mentioned' and point null, so the file does not establish an actual overruling or abrogation of Chandler.

residual_risks: Because lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited both show cap_hit/audit_needed, a complete citator audit could later require a downgrade.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Distinguish the authoritative status field from unaudited proposed progeny signals in the visible treatment note.
